Aiming to leverage my technical and professional expertise to learn and grow in the role.”
SUMMARY & ACHIEVEMENTS
13+ years’ experience in Investment Banking including Settlement & Reconciliation and NAV Pricing operations in various products like Cash Equity, Fixed income, middle office, Securities services and Arbitrage services.
Process Lead for Cash Equity and Fixed Income – Pre-matching, Settlement & Reconciliation operations for EMEA markets Process Migration - Europe to India Via online - Migration of process by Lift and shift from lisbon to Chennai. Four people of workload migrated. (Arbitrage Process)
Pilot Trainer for Core & German markets T2S settlement Structuring Trade Executions/Confirmations in Prime brokerage and Stock Lending settlement & Reconciliation operations Performed 98.7% settlement ratio in IPO stock settlement for Core markets Trained 7 FTEs in pre-matching, settlement and reconciliation and 5 FTEs in post settlement correction and Reconciliation
Total years of Experience – 13 yrs

raw_sections.experience:
Assistant Manager
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Work Chronicle:
BNP PARIBAS GLOBAL SECURITIES OPERATIONS, Chennai Position: Assistant Manager Duration: Nov 2017 - Nov 2025
Job Responsibilites

SWIFT feed analysis and issue handling: Work with custodian in case of any issue with related to SWIFT (MT940/950, MT535). Handle the missing balances in the unknown swift and liaise with custodian to get the required swift feed and perform the reconciliation

PROD readiness of new fund: Ensure to keep the Intellimatch Setup ready for any new account prior to Go-live date and engage with custody to get the MT940/950 & MT535 swifts to ensure smooth Go-live

Transition & Deployment: Actively involving in deployment activities for new Business requirement and perform static setup in Intellimatch, analysis feeds integration & fund closures, STIF inputs etc.
•
Client Handling: Participate in daily & weekly calls with client & oversight representatives, handling escalations and resolving aged exceptions.

FA Admin: Handling fund static setup for new fund launch and Manual statement position posting in Winigate application based on custody statement position

Research and coding outstanding breaks: Perform research for high aged breaks; ensure coding & commenting as per clients. Regular follow-up with internal team & custodian to clear long O/s.

SOP review & sign off: Ensure SOP documents are reviewed internally on periodic basis and it is shared and approved by client on quarterly/Monthly basis.

Team handling & Work allocation: Managing a team of 8 members and ensure client deliverables are met within deadline without compromising quality.

Other activities: Leave management, identifying training requirement, resource allocation, Issue tracker, Error tracker, Over 3 days ticket management and Monthly dash board (MIS Report).
Manage the Change management (BA’s) to understand the Business requirement and provide/Prepare BRD for the development team to Automate.

Data analysis and data validation/gathering from each level to understand the business actuals and the change expected.

Act as an intermediate between the Tech team and the user until the Automation moves to live in Production

Perform regression testing, Unit/UAT testing and confirm the changes are appropriate.

Design the error and defect log between the requirement and the development and close the gaps during UAT testing

Co-ordinate with users/prod support and suggest them the better and simplest way of developing the reconciliation thereby reducing the risk.

Documentation of the problem statement and detailed remediation approach with steps to be followed
Missing Balances: Ensure the missing balances received due to incorrect swift feeds are cleared on the same day. Liaise with custody and get the necessary transactions are uploaded in TLM.

Security Linking: Analyze recon exceptions which not match-off due non-linking of security id or custodian is using the dummy security. Identify the breaks and work with oversight to link the dummy with market known identifiers
Tata Consultancy Services, Bangalore & Chennai
Position : Duration:
Business Analyst Sep 2012 – April 2017
Deutsche Bank – Market Wealth Securities – Reconciliation Operations (Banaglore)
Job Responsibilites

Opening and maintaining of Mirror account in DB and Nostro reconciliation system (NRS)

Upload of Nostro and mirror statements in order to compare with ledger books

Ensuring the processing of daily money market entries on a multi-currency reporting system under stipulated time periods by the team

Postings of Cash transfers, capital withdrawals, deposits, Income and Expenses cash entries

Investigation of outstanding entries to mark to respective department/cost-centre

Rising with correspondent bank for unidentified debits and credits in reconciliation statements.

Escalation with departments for outstanding entries beyond seven days

Cash break investigation between Nostro and Vostro accounts for Futures & Options

Posting Multi currency payments manually if payment cancelled and vouchers for internal transactions

Reconciling the outstanding entries and investigating on the pending items

Identification of duplicate /wrong debits by department on T+1 basis and escalation.
Matching of DD debited in our Nostro account and providing to various departments for reversal from payable account.
Managing SWIFT messages (MT103,202 etc) received from banks and corporate on daily basis Reporting to stake holders on account balances for the day.

Consolidating on matched entries on receipt & payment entries and reporting for reconciliation
•
Handling interest and charges entries and clearing those entries with PNL account Perform complete analysis of stocks and portfolios to ensure smooth and timely execution of transitions involving domestic and international markets.
•
Developing and implementing SOPs for improving the operational efficiency of forex vertical Preparing MIS for the top management
Morgan Stanley – Settlement & Reconciliation Operations (Chennai)
Duration: April 2014 - August 2017
Job Responsibilities

Trade confirmation & affirmation with clients and internal stakeholders (Traders, trade assistants) and sharing SSI/MDI details to Counterparty/Client for instructing trades and Contacting Custodian on status of trades thereby resolving mismatches

Performing Fails investigation on pending trades and ensuring the trades are matched/covered, Also reaching out to desk/Traders for borrows

Escalating the focus trades in a timely basis to client support groups/Sales trader/Traders/Trade assistance thereby providing update on settlement status prior to market cut offs

Pre-matching and settlement of Cross-border settlement– Conversions / ADR Conversions across markets and Instructing dump settlement of shares on physical stocks and Convertible bonds traded between nominals and units

Prioritizing prime brokerage, Record date stocks, Focus client and LIFFE (London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange) Focus client trades, Exchange, MTF, Buy-ins and IPO stocks

Resolving cross-settlement mismatches by reversing the trades into the market after confirming with cpty and custodian
